title: NYDFS Part 500 Certification Builder
description: Build the NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500 annual Certification of Material Compliance (or Acknowledgment of Noncompliance) evidence bundle. Five control domains, material-nonconformity remediation tracking, senior-officer sign-off gate, April 15 deadline math. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.
